# UDreamLyricsLibrary Inherits from `UBlueprintFunctionLibrary`. Declared in `Public/Extensions/Lyrics/DreamLyricsData.h`. Dream Lyrics Library ## Functions | Function | Kind | Description | |---|---|---| | `bool ParseLRC(FString Text, FDreamLyrics& OutLyrics)` | callable | Parse LRC: "[mm:ss.xx]text" lines, with inline word times when present (enhanced LRC). Line ends are the next line's start. | | `bool ParseTTML(FString Xml, FDreamLyrics& OutLyrics, FString& OutError)` | callable | Parse TTML of the kind Apple Music and AMLL use:

lines of words, with ttm:agent for the second voice, ttm:role="x-bg" spans for backing vocals and ttm:role="x-translation" / "x-roman" spans for the secondary texts. A

without word spans becomes one word spanning the line. |
